metadata.title: Radish with Roasted Sesame Salad
metadata.description:
This easy to make and simple radish salad or chutney features commonly on the northeastern platter in different versions. Shredded radish is mixed with roasted and pounded sesame seeds to balance the pungency and seasoned with some salt. This easy to make side dish that goes well with meals.
